The Karachi Kings–Hyderabad Kingsmen rivalry, more commonly known as the Sindh Derby, is a cricket rivalry between two teams in the Pakistan Super League (PSL), a rivalry between the cricket teams of Karachi and Hyderabad that has emerged in the PSL. It is considered one of the most significant rivalries in the PSL, due to the cities' sizes and shared culture, economic output and history as two of Sindh's most influential urban centres. Despite being located in the same province of Sindh, the two teams historically have not maintained the same intensity of rivalry as in the PSL, with Karachi's domestic teams excelling, whereas Hyderabad has domestically been one of the weaker sides.
Both teams have played on 1 occasion against each other, in the 2026 season, with Hyderabad Kingsmen winning the first encounter in their debut season.
